title: Whispering Fog Bank
description: Thick sea fog spills through the passage, swallowing the walls in grey. Faint whispers ride the current, half-words in a language older than the stone. Condensation beads on every surface, cold and briny.

choices.label: Follow the whispers
choices.description: The voices might lead to hidden treasure -- or hidden danger.

outcomes.text: The voices lead you through a maze of fog to a forgotten alcove. Coin and salt crystals are scattered across the stone shelf.
The whispers lead to a modest cache of coins wedged in a rock crevice. Not bad for trusting the fog.
The fog thickens and the whispers become screams. A spectral chill courses through your party before the mist clears, leaving everyone shaken and numb.

choices.label: Collect the condensation
choices.description: The fog leaves behind pure salt residue on stone.

outcomes.text: You scrape crystallized salt from the walls. The fog deposits are unusually pure.
The deposits are thin here. You gather what you can before the fog begins to dissipate.

choices.label: Retreat from the fog
choices.description: Nothing good follows voices in the fog.

outcomes.text: You back away from the fog bank. The whispers fade behind you, disappointed.
